text:
maria (HW Partnerships): Proposing a 2-week joint perf pilot with NovaEdge focused on perf/W + throughput and a small kernel carveout experiment. Goal: reproducible numbers for marketplace listing and a coordinated announcement if results are good.
linh (NovaEdge): Sounds good. We can provision 4 dev nodes (A2000 variants) and share low-level telemetry. Proposed start: week of Apr 14.
aj (Perf Eng): OK. Need the exact model + token distribution. Suggest two tracks: (1) steady-state throughput (long-run tokens/s) and (2) p95/p99 latency with short sequences. Also we should capture power telemetry every 1s.
sam (Runtime): I can add a feature-flagged carveout path to the runtime that toggles our kernel selection heuristics. Will need a brief smoketest harness and the partner kernel build. ETA 3 business days after we get kernel patch.
tess (Product): Two asks: (a) make sure any numbers we surface in marketplace are clearly labeled "pilot" and (b) set an embargo window for joint PR until both sides sign off.
maria (HW Partnerships): Agreed. Draft scope: model=redwood/llama-13b-v2-serve, seqs: 32/128/512, steady runs: 30m each, batch sizes: 1,4,8. Capture power, gpu_util, tokens/s, p95_ms, kernel_variant.
linh (NovaEdge): We'll share kernel patch (repo link) and a compiled image. Patch id: NV-ker-42. We'll also attach IPMI and PDUs for per-rack watt readings.
aj (Perf Eng): Minimal telemetry schema (csv header) we want: timestamp,model,seq_len,batch,gpu_power_w,gpu_util_pct,tokens_per_s,p95_ms,kernel_variant,run_id. Please use that exact header so our ingestion works.
benchbot: benchbot: job created -> bench/novaedge/1709234567-coop-smoke, cluster=coop-sprint, target_nodes=4, out=s3://redwood-partners/novaedge/1709234567/summary.json
sam (Runtime): Quick smoke command for partner to run once image is on device:
```
./run_bench --model redwood/llama-13b-v2 --seq 512 --batch 4 --iters 10000 --device /dev/nova0 --profile=power,latency --out summary.json
```
linh (NovaEdge): I'll run that and upload to the S3 path. Also will include raw perf counters and our kernel config: CONFIG_NOVA_OPT=1, CONFIG_KV_PREFETCH=1.
aj (Perf Eng): After we get smoke results, we'll run full matrix and a kernel A/B sweep: baseline vs carveout flags. We should run each cell at least 3x and report median tokens/s + power mean.
tess (Product): Timeline check: smoke this week, full sweep next week, internal review week after. Proposed embargo lift target: Apr 28.
maria (HW Partnerships): I'll draft a short runbook with roles (who runs, who ingests, who checks regressions). Also will add a checklist for marketplace listing fields (model, hw, perf/W, test conditions, disclaimers).
linh (NovaEdge): One ask: include a small blurb about kernel contributions in the joint PR. We'll want attribution for the kernel perf work.
aj (Perf Eng): Noted. We'll keep a change log and a reproducibility note. Also running a quick kernel perf test: toggle NV-ker-42 on/off and measure tokens/s at seq=128, batch=4.
benchbot: benchbot: first smoke completed -> s3://redwood-partners/novaedge/1709234567/summary.json (md5: d41d8cd98f00b204e9800998ecf8427e).
sam (Runtime): I pulled the smoke results, nothing catastrophic. p95 within expected range, small ~6% tokens/s uplift with carveout flagged. I'll schedule the full sweep tomorrow.
maria (HW Partnerships): Great. Next actions: Linh upload kernel binary + IPMI creds (secure channel), AJ to kick off sweep matrix tomorrow, Sam to finalize runtime flag and ensure toggleable at runtime, Tess to prepare draft marketplace blurb. Keep comms here for quick sync. :thumbsup:
